summary.tldr: Removes a Criminal Code defence for wilful promotion of hatred or antisemitism when the person says they were arguing a religious opinion in good faith.
what_it_does: Repeals the Criminal Code defence that lets a person avoid liability for wilful promotion of hatred if they said they were giving a good faith opinion on a religious subject.
Repeals the Criminal Code defence that lets a person avoid liability for wilful promotion of antisemitism if they said they were giving a good faith opinion based on a religious text.
Sets the bill to come into force 30 days after royal assent.
who_it_affects: People charged with hate promotion offences
summary.background: The bill changes section 319 of the Criminal Code. It removes two specific defences from that section.
